message.content: No, the drones in our fleet aren’t alike at all. They come in different models from different manufacturers, each with its own limits—how much they can carry, how far they can fly, and what sensors they have, like cameras or thermal scanners. They also use different charging connectors, and those aren’t interchangeable, so a drone can only charge on its own company’s pads at its home site. That means I have to keep track of which drone goes where and how to charge it.
